name: DEGREES
description: DEGREES converts an angle measured in radians to degrees.

parameters.name: angle
parameters.description: The angle in radians that you want to convert to degrees.

basicExample.explanation: π radians equals 180°, so the result is 180.

howItWorks: DEGREES multiplies the radian value by 180/π to produce the equivalent degree measure. It is the inverse of RADIANS.

howToSteps.name: Select the cell
howToSteps.text: Click the cell for the degree result.

limitations: It only converts radians to degrees, not the reverse (use RADIANS for that).

commonErrors.fix: Supply a numeric angle in radians.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: DEGREES works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: What is the formula DEGREES uses?
How do I go back to radians?
faq.answer: Use RADIANS(degrees), which multiplies by π/180.

faq.question: Why use DEGREES instead of multiplying by 180/PI()?
faq.answer: It is clearer and avoids manually typing the constant; results are identical.
